milestones.title: Playing the Attacker
milestones.when: bao: request made with the leaked token (not wired: the shell hook drops a leading `BAO_TOKEN=...`; needs a `bao` audit event by the leaked token's accessor)

milestones.title: Read the Audit Log
milestones.joke: What did it do? Now you know.

milestones.title: Revoke the Tree
milestones.joke: Killed the token and its children.
milestones.when: shell: `bao token revoke -accessor ...` (exit 0); revoking a token revokes its children

milestones.title: Rotated What It Read
milestones.when: shell: `bao kv put` or `patch` on `team/app` or `team/ci` (exit 0)

milestones.title: The App Recovers
milestones.when: verify: app serving with the new secret (not wired: needs an HTTP verb on `app-host`)
